_note: Cross-family blend (Carthaginian + Iberian): a silver-rich native trade-kingdom (a Tartessos) acculturated by Punic commerce - the Iberian substrate enriched and overlaid by Phoenician-Punic trade, letters and cult. Backbone = Iberian (classical family, the Cantabran register: -briga place-names, Celtiberian roots); overlay = Punic (near_eastern, the Barcan register: Qart-/Mahoz- trade-toponyms, the suffete-magistracy, the silver trade). civ = feudal (a mercantile monarchy; merchant-magistrates as flavor). Seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Iberian/Punic registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Iberian primary, Punic variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Iberian backbone (Latinate vowels over a Celtic substrate; hard c/k; -o/-a/-briga/-ica endings; clusters br/gr/nt) with a Punic overlay (the construct chain Qart-/Mahoz-/Beth-, feminine -t, the trade register); theophoric on the Iberian morphs (Caiandos-, Orlanno-) with Punic variants (Arganz-, Tulrish-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; clusters br/gr/nt/mb/st; penultimate stress; Punic construct chains in trade-names.

morphology.patronymic_form: Iberian patronymic -iz; clan/gens for the nobility; the Punic overlay adds bin-X among the merchant-houses and theophoric trade-names.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature, or feature + -briga; Argento-briga (silver-fort); the Punic overlay yields Qart-[name] and Mahoz-[resource] (Mahoz-Argento = silver-port).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a silver-kingdom; the king over hillfort-lords and the Punic-styled merchant-magistracy of the great ports)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Iberian/Celtiberian backbone, ascending, with a Punic overlay at the trade-tiers. Brigant (hillfort-lord) barony; Limigant (border-warden) march; Tigern (lord) county; Shophet (suffete - the Punic merchant-magistrate, here a ducal office over the great ports) duchy; Vergobret (high magistrate) principality; Rix (king) kingdom; Argantho-Rix (the Silver-King, after the silver wealth) over the realm. The merchant-houses of the qart-ports rival the hillfort-lords. (Rank titles are the real Iberian/Punic register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + patronymic (-iz) + clan; the merchant-houses of the ports add a Punic theophoric trade-name (abd-X) or a bin-X patronymic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the hillfort nobility keep Iberian names; the port merchant-houses use Punic trade-names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Iberian devotional names on the morphed deity-stems; the Punic merchant-houses use abd-X (servant-of) on the trade-power: e.g. Caiando-iz, Abd-Arganz.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Iberian primary, from the Cantabran register; Punic variant, from the Barcan register), never real Iberian/Phoenician gods. The silver-trade exalts the commerce-power above all. Tartessan seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The hillfort grove and the Punic port-tophet keep the rites.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; Punic variant Atharon) - the One, the high maker; acknowledged when Neutral, reviled as the far tyrant when Chaotic; petitioned by neither

sample_deity_renames.Argentus: Arganz (Punic) / Arganno (Iberian) - trade, silver and the city; exalted by the silver-kingdom
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Caiandos - the enduring earth (and its silver veins); Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraxos (Iberian) / Maraksh (Punic) - the war-fire; Chaotic power

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraxos, Desoryos, Lusanto the coin-serpent), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - the commerce-power (Arganz) foremost; the ancestral dead and the hillfort/port spirits honored

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Burning (Punic Maraksh the Devourer); Vacidus -> Bacaid the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusanto the Coin-Serpent (the trader's curse).

clergy_ladder.9: Rab-Kohen (high priest of the great port)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemeton (sacred grove) of [power] on the hillforts, and the Beth (temple) of [power] in the ports: 'the Nemeton of Caiandos', 'the Beth of Arganz'.
religion.saints_pattern: ancestral hillfort-heroes (the [name] of [briga]) and deified founder-merchants of the ports (the Blessed [name]).

holy_symbol_motifs.Arganz: scales and a silver ingot over a trading-ship
holy_symbol_motifs.Caiandos: a grey peak threaded with silver veins
holy_symbol_motifs.Rialta: a triangle beneath a disc and crescent

banks_patterns.ships: silver-trade ship names: 'Bringer of Argento', 'the Silver Star', 'Wave of Arganz'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [clan] Spears / the [port] Sacred Band: 'the Iron Spears of [briga]', 'the Sacred Band of Mahoz-Argento'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'O/A [Adjective] [Noun]': 'A Ancora de Prata' (the silver anchor), 'O Touro Negro' (the black bull)
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: drowned silver-ports and ruined castros: 'as Ruinas de [name]', 'the Tophet of Qart-[name]'
